pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark regions with serrated, high-frequency edge gradients. Relative spatial area of patches is larger on the cervical region and decreases in size toward the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-toned topological network with variable pixel thickness. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial, maintaining high continuity across the visible lateral surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette of the mane visible against the background along the upper neck profile.
